candidates.change_summary: Change returned owner to msg.sender instead of the stored _owner (so owner() returns caller address).
Require newOwner not zero removed, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)) to set owner to zero without reverting.
Add an extra require that newOwner must equal current owner, preventing changes to owner unless same address (so no-op unless same); changes observable owner after call.
Relax onlyOwner check to compare against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, allowing transferOwnership to be callable via contracts in different ways, altering observed behavior.
Change setRewardDistributor to require onlyOwner removed and instead set rewardDistributor to tx.origin, allowing distributor to be overridden to the transaction origin rather than provided argument.
Assign rewardDistributor to the zero address regardless of input, causing rewardDistributor to always be cleared when called.
Swap assignment to set rewardDistributor to the provided address only if it's non-zero; otherwise keep previous value (no change when zero passed).
Set rewardDistributor to the caller (msg.sender) instead of the provided _distributor, making the caller become distributor.
Modify onlyOwner to check owner against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, changing who is authorized to call setRewardDistributor.
Remove owner check inside onlyOwner (no-op), allowing anyone to call setRewardDistributor and thus change rewardDistributor.
